title: Getting Around
text:
Many people travel every day. Some people go to work by bus. Others take the train or ride a bicycle. Trains are fast and comfortable.

Airplanes are good for long trips. My friend flew to London last summer. He took a taxi from the airport to his hotel. The trip was short and easy.

questions.text: How do some people go to work?
Where did the friend fly last summer?
How did the friend probably feel about the trip?
What does the passage suggest about people who take the train to work?

vocabulary.definition: to go from one place to another, often far away
feeling good and relaxed, with no pain or problems
vehicles with wings that fly people or things through the air
a place where airplanes take off and land

paragraph_translations: Birçok insan her gün seyahat eder. Bazı insanlar işe otobüsle gider. Diğerleri trene biner ya da bisiklete biner. Trenler hızlı ve rahattır.
Uçaklar uzun yolculuklar için iyidir. Arkadaşım geçen yaz Londra'ya uçtu. Havalimanından otele bir taksiyle gitti. Yolculuk kısa ve kolaydı.
